name: aws_ec2_status_check_failed
title: EC2 instance failing status checks
description: An EC2 instance failed its StatusCheckFailed check in at least 2 one-minute datapoints within 10 minutes. The instance or its host is broken. Stopping or terminating instances can also trip it. A datapoint delivered twice counts once (one row per instance and minute).

query_condition.sql: SELECT instance, account_id, region, count(*) AS failing_minutes FROM (SELECT dimensions_instanceid AS instance, account_id, region, timestamp, max(value_max) AS v FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/EC2' AND metric_name = 'StatusCheckFailed' AND dimensions_instanceid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY instance, account_id, region, timestamp) AS t WHERE v >= 1 GROUP BY instance, account_id, region HAVING count(*) >= 2

row_template: EC2 {instance} ({account_id}/{region}) failed status checks in {failing_minutes} datapoints
